highlights.title: Move a project's folder
highlights.line: If you moved a project's folder, its settings now ask where it is, and Kosmos uses it from there.

highlights.title: A steadier top bar
highlights.line: On a computer that always shows scrollbars, the top bar no longer jumps when you switch views.

highlights.title: Codex agents in their own space
highlights.line: Codex agents now run with their own settings, so plugins and settings in your own Codex app no longer affect them.
